title: Alert
description: An anomaly detected on a machine. Published on Kafka alertas by the anomaly service. Every field is required and null counts as missing. Unknown fields are ignored.

alert_id.description: Unique alert identifier, a lowercase UUID.

machine_id.description: Machine identifier, same rules as in telemetry.

ts.description: Detection time in RFC 3339, with time zone.

value.description: Observed value, in the unit of the alert type: degrees Celsius for temperatura_alta, g for vibracao_alta, seconds stopped for parada_longa.

threshold.description: Limit that was crossed, in the same unit as value.
